senses.gloss: (b. h. שָׂרַג ; Saf. of אָרַג), Pi. סֵירֵג [to interlace, plait,]

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:1">Kel. XVI, 1</cite> <he>משיְסָרֵג בה וכ׳</he> from the time he made three meshes of girthing.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:12">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 12</cite> <he>סֵירְגוֹ במשיחית וכ׳</he> if he strapped it (the disjointed frame) with cords &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:4">B. Mets. IX, 4</cite> [read:] <he>שהוא מְסָרֵג בו את המטה</he> with which one girths the bedstead.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 1:8">M. Kat. I, 8</cite> <he>ומסָרְגִין את המטות</he> you may girth the bedsteads (during the festive week).
Y. Ber. III, beg. 5ᵈ, a. e. כל שמסרגין על וכ׳ a bedstead on which the girths are drawn on top is called miṭṭah, when drawn beneath, dargesh; Ned. 56ᵇ (v. אַבְקָתָא); a. fr.—Trnsf.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> (ref. to the chronological disorder in the Book of Daniel, in going from Belshazzar (ch. V) to Darius (ch. VI), again to the first year of B. (ch. VII), and to the third year of B. (ch. VIII)) unite <he>כדי לסָרֵג על וכ׳</he> in order to combine the entire section as one written in the spirit of holiness; Yalk. ib. 144; Yalk. Dan. 1063 <he>לִסְרוֹג</he> (perh. to be read <he>לסָרֵיג</he>).—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to make a partition by means of net-work, like lattices &c.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Menahot 10:23">Tosef. Men. X, 23</cite> <he>ומסרגין שם כנגד וכ׳</he> and there they fence in an area of about three S’ah.—Part. pass. <he>מְסוֹרָג</he>.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to do a thing in a manner in which straps are drawn in bedsteads &c., i.e. in zig-zag; to skip.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 9:3">Tosef. Nidd. IX, 3</cite> <he>סֵירְגָה לה וכ׳</he> if she skipped four days (beyond the ordinary period of menstruation); <cite ref="Niddah 64a:25">Nidd. 64ᵃ</cite> <he>סירגה ליום וכ׳</he> if she skipped (from the twenty-first) to the twenty-fourth day.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 7:1:10">Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ובלבד במְסָרְגִין לו</he> provided they put cross-questions to him alternately (one question to which a positive, and one to which a negative answer are expected, so as to test his sanity).—Part. pass. <he>מְסוֹרָג</he>; f. <he>מְסוֹרֶגֶת</he>; pl. <he>מְסוֹרָגִים</he>, <he>מְסוֹרָגִין</he>; <he>מְסוֹרָגוֹת</he>. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod. s. 6 [read as:] <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 292:1">Yalk. Ex. 292</cite> (ref. to Ex.XX, 5) <he>בזמן שהן אינן מסורגין או בזמן שהן מס׳</he> (not <he>מסרגין</he>) are the sins of the fathers visited upon the children when the succession is uninterrupted, or even when interrupted (by a good generation)? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:4:7">Y. Snh. I, 19ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מס׳ עלו</he> the differently marked ballots came up alternately.

senses.gloss: to write in broken lines (leaving a vacant space in the middle of the line); to spread.
units: <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:11">Treat. Sof’rim I, 11</cite> <he>מְסָרְגוֹ וכ׳</he> he spreads the writing so as to make a small column of it.—Part. pass. as ab.

<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>רצוף שעשאו מס׳ או מס׳ וכ׳</he> if he wrote in broken lines what is to be written in continuous lines or vice versa; <he>או שעשה המס׳ שלא כהלכתו</he> or if he did the spreading not in accordance with the rule.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: to trace cross-lines on stone, to carve designs. Pesik. ‘Ăniya, p. 137ᵃ מְסָרְגִין בו carving it; Yalk. Is. 339 (omitted in Pesik. R. s. 32); v. סָתַת.—V. סִירוּג.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be provided with girths, be strapped.
units: Ned. 56ᵇ אי מטה מִסְתָּרֶגֶת על גבה if it be, that miṭṭah is a couch, the straps of which are drawn over the frame &c.
